title: EEG field kit per-unit test record
description: The machine-readable per-unit record of TST-EEG-004 Rev C section 12, one file per unit named `<unit_serial>_test.json`. Section 12 fixes the field counts 'so a record can be validated mechanically'; every count it states is a minItems == maxItems pair in this schema, so a short array is a schema error and not a silent gap. Generated by records/make_records.py from TST-EEG-004 Rev C. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0.

schema.description: The schema this record claims to satisfy.

record_type.description: `production` for a record of a unit that was tested; `example` for the worked example shipped with the schema. The validator refuses to accept an `example` record as a deliverable under RFQ-EEG-001 section 9.3.
